add.issue.name: llama-swap stats poller reloads a model right after it is unloaded

edit.description.md:
LlamaSwapStats polls `GET <host>/upstream/<model>/slots` once a second. llama-swap treats a request on its /upstream proxy as demand and loads the model, so a manual unload is undone within about a second: `/running` shows the model `starting` again right after `POST /api/models/unload`. TTL unloads stick only because the model leaves `/running` before the next poll.

Fix: poll only while the model's state is `ready`, and when llama-swap is on loopback, read `/slots` straight from the backend port listed in `/running` (`proxy`). A stopped backend refuses the connection instead of loading anything. Remote hosts keep the /upstream path, gated on `ready`.

Verify: unload the loaded model with the shell running; `/running` stays empty, and the stats still update during generation.

add.issue.comment.md: Solution: PR #262 (fix/llama-swap-stats-no-reload). Verified live with the patched file in the installed shell: after `POST /api/models/unload`, `/running` stayed empty for 20 s (before the fix it was `starting` again within half a second). A generation afterwards worked, no new /upstream slot polls appeared, and the widget had open connections to the backend port. How the stats look on screen is for review.

edit.description.md:
From a homelab-side audit of global Claude Code tool bloat (2026-09-25): `.claude/settings.json` here is gitignored (per-machine, local only), currently has `superpowers@claude-plugins-official: true` (kept — "superpowers doc planning" is the one skill actually used, both boots) and, as of tonight, `qt-development-skills@claude-plugins-official: true` — moved here from user/global scope because it's not used anywhere else (disabled globally in `harnesses/claude/settings.managed.json` on the homelab side).

Open questions for this repo specifically:
1. **Is qt-development-skills still needed here at all?** The operator set up `~/docs-local` last night (offline, version-exact Qt 6.11.2 QML + Quickshell 0.3.1 docs, a zvec-grep workspace — see homelab `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`). If that fully covers what qt-development-skills provided (Qt/QML doc lookup), this plugin may be redundant even project-scoped here. If it does more than doc lookup (lint rules, snippets, agent skills beyond reference docs), it's worth keeping.
2. **Marketplace `qt-skills-and-tools`** (`TheQtCompanyRnD/agent-skills`) is registered on aphotic globally but nothing is installed from it — dead registration, safe to deregister unless something here actually wants it.
3. **Superpowers scope check:** confirm only the doc-planning skill within `superpowers` is actually exercised in this repo's workflow (that's the only one used on Windows too) — if the plugin ships other skills that are dead weight, consider whether a narrower enablement is possible.
4. General sweep: any other project-level `.claude/` config (agents, hooks, MCP servers) accumulated here that isn't actually earning its context cost in a normal Aphotic-Hypr session. Check with `/context` in a live session here.

Not urgent — file for whenever this board's maintainer (or trevin) has time. No pruning decided yet beyond what's noted above.
